title: Rebound and Outlet
description: A rebounder secures a missed shot, pivots away from traffic and finds the outlet on the same side, the first pass of every fast break.

content.objective: Secure the rebound with two hands, turn to the outside and outlet the ball quickly to a guard at the free-throw line extended.
content.setup: Coach shoots from the top; a rebounder in the lane; outlet players on each wing at the free-throw line extended.
content.organization: Rebounder to outlet to dribble to the far end; next group goes when the ball is past half court.
instructions: The coach shoots and misses on purpose.
The rebounder jumps, catches with two hands and chins the ball.
Pivot to the outside, toward the sideline the ball came off.
Outlet to the guard on that side with a chest or overhead pass.
The guard pushes the ball up the floor and finishes.
coachingPoints: Chin the ball: elbows out, ball under the chin.
Turn to the outside, away from the middle traffic.
The outlet player calls for the ball and shows a target.
commonMistakes: Bringing the ball down to the waist where it can be stripped.
Pivoting into the middle of the lane.
Outlet guard standing too far away, under the half-court line.
content.safety: Only one rebounder jumps at a time unless the variation adds contact.
progressions: Add a second rebounder who contests.
Outlet must happen within two seconds.
regressions: Coach tosses the ball gently off the board.
variations: Outlet to the middle when the wing is denied.
Rebounder dribbles out if no outlet is open.
successCriteria: Outlet released within two seconds of landing.
Rebound secured with two hands on every rep.
content.gameApplication: The faster the outlet, the more fast-break points; this links defensive rebounding to transition.
